embedded_ivos.text: We need to regulate these companies. We need to pass bills like the Kill Switch Act to make sure that we can pull the plug on this technology if it poses a threat to all of us. And we need to make sure that we require third-party verification that these models are safe, because right now they're not.

deepseek.reason: The speaker calls for third-party verification of model safety, not embedded on-site or continuous internal access.
deepseek.confidence_reason: Third-party verification alone does not meet the rubric's embedded-IVO requirement.
